set -e; echo '=== WAV METRICS ==='; python3 -c 'import hashlib,math,struct,wave; load=lambda p:(lambda w:(w.getframerate(),w.getnchannels(),w.readframes(w.getnframes())))(wave.open(p,"rb")); ra,ca,a=load("/tmp/phase1c_ref.wav"); rb,cb,b=load("/tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav"); sa=struct.unpack("<%dh"%(len(a)//2),a); sb=struct.unpack("<%dh"%(len(b)//2),b); rms=lambda s: math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in s)/max(1,len(s))); n=min(len(sa),len(sb)); print("ref_rate=%d ref_channels=%d ref_bytes=%d ref_sha256=%s ref_rms=%.2f"%(ra,ca,len(a),hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),rms(sa))); print("pcm_rate=%d pcm_channels=%d pcm_bytes=%d pcm_sha256=%s pcm_rms=%.2f"%(rb,cb,len(b),hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),rms(sb))); print("aligned_mean_abs_diff=%.2f"%(sum(abs(sa[i]-sb[i]) for i in range(n))/max(1,n)))'; echo '=== REFERENCE TRANSCRIPT ==='; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift --locale pl-PL /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav || true; echo '=== PCM TRANSCRIPT ==='; swift scripts/transcribe_audio.swift --locale pl-PL /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav || true; rm -f /tmp/phase1c_ref.wav /tmp/phase1c_pcm.wav /tmp/phase1c_apk_path /tmp/ref-ui.xml /tmp/ref-keypad.xml /tmp/uiauto1.out /tmp/uiauto2.out; echo phase1c_silent_remote_dtmf_proof_complete=true
